candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender]=0;` so credit is never reset after withdrawal, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same credit and leaving different state after withdrawAll.
Delete the statement `balance-=oCredit;` so the contract balance is not decremented, leaving a different balance state after withdrawAll.
Delete the statement `__lock_modifier0_lock = true;` from the modifier so reentrancy is no longer prevented, exposing the reentrancy bug and changing resulting state after withdrawAll.
Delete the statement `__lock_modifier0_lock = false;` from the modifier so the lock stays permanently engaged and every subsequent withdrawAll call reverts, changing observable behavior.
Remove the statement that sets the lock to true before the function body, disabling the reentrancy guard so reentrant calls to withdrawAll are allowed.
Remove the statement that resets the lock to false after the function body, so the guard permanently blocks any subsequent call to withdrawAll.
Remove the reset of the caller's credit to zero, so a second call to withdrawAll withdraws the same credit again (double withdrawal).
Remove the require(callResult) check, so withdrawal state updates (and value semantics) proceed even when the external call fails.
Delete `credit[msg.sender]=0;` so callers' credit is never cleared, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same credit.
Delete `balance-=oCredit;` so the contract's balance is not decremented on withdrawal.
Replace `require(callResult);` with `require(!callResult);` so withdrawals revert when the transfer succeeds and only 'succeed' when it fails.
Move `credit[msg.sender]=0;` to before the external call (checks-effects-interactions), removing the reentrancy double-withdrawal window.
Replace `require(!__lock_modifier0_lock);` with `require(__lock_modifier0_lock);` so the guard only proceeds when already locked, making withdrawAll revert on every call.
Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = false;` after the function body so the lock is never released, making any second withdrawAll (or other guarded call) revert.
